d0.rule: R0.2 may not validate or derive any row whose required clock or requested outcome horizon reaches P1_PROTECTED.

legacy_rule: candidate_second must never be substituted for an exact source-event timestamp or exact book anchor. For the frozen one-second candidate policy only, the deterministic interval-close boundary (candidate_second + 1 second) may be used as the conservative candidate-availability timestamp.
revision_reason: Historical source review showed the recovered exact book-state anchor can precede frozen one-second candidate availability; candidate and anchor clocks are distinct and need not be ordered relative to each other.
